description: This file implements MCP (Machine Capabilities Protocol) capability discovery for MCP servers, handling both static and dynamic discovery methods including starting local servers, connecting via HTTP, and parsing various server metadata files. It includes complex process management, JSON-RPC communication, and static code analysis for Node.js and Python servers.

classes.name: MCPCapability
classes.description: Represents a discovered MCP server capability, including server info, tools, resources, endpoint, and transport.

classes.name: CapabilityDiscovery
classes.description: Handles the discovery process of MCP server capabilities, including static analysis, live discovery via process management, and caching.

methods.name: NewCapabilityDiscovery
methods.description: Creates a new CapabilityDiscovery instance with provided config and project path.

methods.name: DiscoverCapabilities
methods.description: Discovers capabilities from all installed MCP servers in the project directory.

methods.name: discoverServerCapability
methods.description: Discovers capabilities for a specific MCP server by reading metadata and attempting live or static discovery.

methods.name: CacheCapabilities
methods.description: Caches the discovered capabilities (tools and resources) into a JSON file.

methods.name: GetServerCapability
methods.description: Retrieves capabilities for a specific server, invoking the main discovery logic.

methods.name: discoverLiveCapabilities
methods.description: Attempts to discover capabilities by starting the server process or querying remote URL.

methods.name: tryStdioDiscovery
methods.description: Performs capability discovery via stdio pipes with timeout, involving JSON-RPC messaging.

methods.name: performDiscoveryWithPipes
methods.description: Handles JSON-RPC protocol exchange over pipes with timeouts to discover tools and resources.

methods.name: discoverFromStaticAnalysis
methods.description: Falls back to static code analysis if dynamic discovery fails, handling Node.js and Python servers.
